answer: The bug was in `semver::display::Version::fmt` where the length calculation for padding was incorrect (it had a `- 1` instead of a `+ 1` for the major version component). I corrected this to ensure proper alignment.

The bug was in the `do_len` calculation within `Version::fmt`. It incorrectly subtracted 1 from the length of the major version component (`digits(self.major) - 1`), which caused misalignment when padding the version string. I corrected it to `digits(self.major) + 1`, ensuring that all components (major, minor, patch, prerelease, and build metadata) are correctly accounted for in the total length calculation.
